title: Explicit ordered simplex path and endpoint pullback
statement: For a category C with pullbacks and binary products and simplicial objects U,V [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], the doubling functor sends [n] to the ordered join [n] followed by [n], of dimension 2n+1, and sends each monotone map to its action on each block. Precomposing V with its opposite defines the ordinal path object, with the first and second block endpoint maps. For a,b:U to V define K to be their endpoint pullback. Its first projection c:K to U has a specified elementary simplicial homotopy from ca to cb.

source.place: Tag 01GS (lemma-homotopy), endpoint construction; ordered-join variant using Tag 01GN

proof.text: Define the doubled map blockwise. An increasing input stays in one block, or passes from the first to the second; this proves monotonicity. Evaluate at each block to prove identity, composition and naturality of both endpoints.

For each cut i in degree n, send vertices j at most i to the first block with value j and vertices above i to the second block with value n+j. The seven simplicial homotopy identities follow from the vertex formulas for cofaces and codegeneracies, separating the inequalities defining the cut. Apply V contravariantly to obtain the endpoint homotopy.

Take the categorical pullback of (a,b) and the pair of endpoints. Projecting its pullback equation to either product factor gives the endpoint equations. Precompose the cut homotopy with the second projection. Evaluation preserves the pullback and product limits, giving the stated degreewise lifting and extensionality API.
